title: A big house with a large second floor, white walls in the interior, no lights & a thing of haunting dread

classification.question_topic: Asks if anyone else has experienced a similar dream/nightmare scenario (needing to not look at something haunting).

meta.author_theory: Haunting presence reflects the dreamer's fear; sense of 'looking into someone else's dream/nightmare.'

position.relative_to: second floor hallway; perspective from top right corner of the hallway

qualities.raw_description: large second floor; interior white walls; lights are out; dark gloom with a bluish tint; dark varnished wood floors 'something to skid around'; all the doors are closed; hallway with a door at the end

locations.location_name: public facility between a leisure centre with a pool & a youth club

qualities.raw_description: empty places; a public facility somewhere between a leisure centre with a pool and a youth club; old buildings, big buildings, many hallways

interactions.description: From a viewpoint in the second-floor hallway (top right corner perspective), a haunting female-presenting figure approaches the closed door at the end of the hall and makes a sound (between a moan and an inhuman groan) that starts soft and grows louder.

entities_involved.description: Something that used to be a woman; long dead; not rotting; 'whatever features she had in life are gone,' now 'just a husk'; outside the door at the end of the hall; vocalizes (moan/inhuman groan) increasing in volume.

interactions.description: Dreamer feels they cannot look at the scene/figure; if they look, 'something will happen.' They try not to look; when attempting to get away, they cannot; turning their head results in the entity being there again.

entities_involved.description: The same haunting figure that reappears when the dreamer turns their head; described as needing the dreamer to look at it.

interactions.transaction_blocker: Dreamer cannot get away; entity reappears when they turn their head; sense that looking triggers an event.

interactions.description: In similar 'empty places' (old, big buildings with many hallways), the dreamer gets caught up trying to leave the location or an event goes on there; they are left on their own instead of leaving with other people.

extraction.extraction_notes: Primary described scene is the second-floor hallway in a large unfamiliar house; the public facility/leisure-centre/youth-club setting is mentioned as another similar nightmare location without a full scene. Time flow is not described, but there is a sequence (sound grows louder), so has_temporal_data marked true.
